atoms.text:
Silvy's conclusion:
To conclude, I can say that I am truly thankful for moving to Australia. I enjoy my new life and don't miss my old home so much anymore. Most importantly, I look forward to all the new experiences I am going to make in the next months.

Finnian's conclusion:
All in all, my last few months in Australia had been truly exciting. The most influential experience for me so far has definitely been meeting so many new people. Getting out of my comfort zone influenced me a lot in terms of character, and I am really thankful for that.
